abstract: The U.S. Trade Representative has determined the U.S. dollar procurement thresholds to implement certain U.S. trade agreement obligations, as of January 1, 2026, for calendar years 2026 and 2027.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: This notice is applicable on January 1, 2026, for calendar years 2026 and 2027.
title: Procurement Thresholds for Implementation of the Trade Agreements Act of 1979
